verdict.rationale: Undermind is a research SaaS, not an agent, so the MCP-server axis applies. It documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.undermind.ai/mcp with setup instructions for Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code, Codex, Copilot, ChatGPT and other MCP clients, plus a defined set of exposed tools (deep literature review, full-text reading, search, notes, folders). A probe confirms the documented server. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration that the MCP server works in practice.
